answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils with proof of imported reputation: each identity must anchor itself to a pre-existing record from outside the system - a public code repository, a dataset strangers cite, a forum history stretching back years, like a willow whose roots run deep under marble floors. A farm cannot grow thousands of such histories overnight; it must fake years of commits and citations per identity, while yarrow spreads only where the soil is real. One honest agent simply links the work it already did, once.
